<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="טבת_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916134_theRebbe_917" batchId="meluket-_D7_98_D7_91_D7_AA_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916134_theRebbe_917__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Torah and prayer correspond respectively to the aspect of "downward without end" and "upward without end" of Ein Sof, with prayer being higher than Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, it is explained in the above discourses,</t>
    <t s="2">that Torah and prayer are analogous to the two aspects of above, upward without end, and below, downward without end.</t>
    <t s="3">For Torah, which is an influence from above to below,</t>
    <t s="4">is analogous to the aspect of "downward without end,"</t>
    <t s="5">and prayer, which is an elevation from below to above, is analogous to the aspect of "upward without end."</t>
    <t s="6">And according to the known principle</t>
    <t s="7">that this [aspect] that Ein Sof is "downward without end"</t>
    <t s="8">(the root of Torah)</t>
    <t s="9">is the matter of expansion and revelation,</t>
    <t s="10">which expands and is revealed downward, downward without end,</t>
    <t s="11">and this [aspect] that Ein Sof is "upward without end" is like that which is elevated and included in His Essence, upward, upward without end,</t>
    <t s="12">it is understood</t>
    <t s="13">that prayer is higher than Torah.</t>
    <t s="14">And the request "Ad-noy, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise" is,</t>
    <t s="15">that in prayer, which is from below to above, there should also be the quality of Torah,</t>
    <t s="16">from above to below.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Prayer involves self-nullification, elevating from below to above, while Torah is a descent from above to below that clothes itself in the intellect of the person.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">The explanation is,</t>
    <t s="1">that prayer is when a person requests and prays,</t>
    <t s="2">and also the influence that comes through prayer,</t>
    <t s="3">that the Holy One, blessed be He, fulfills his request,</t>
    <t s="4">is from the aspect of the quality of the work of the lower being,</t>
    <t s="5">"You desire the work of Your hands."</t>
    <t s="6">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="7">that the reason for this, that one must stand in prayer like a servant before his master with awe, fear, and dread,</t>
    <t s="8">is,</t>
    <t s="9">that this [fact] that the work of the lower being</t>
    <t s="10">(prayer)</t>
    <t s="11">arouses above the will to fulfill his request, is</t>
    <t s="12">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="13">because in the work of the lower being there is the quality of self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="14">therefore,</t>
    <t s="15">the more prayer is with greater self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="16">the more it arouses above to fulfill his request.</t>
    <t s="17">And this is that prayer is an elevation from below to above,</t>
    <t s="18">because the request of prayer is with self-nullification</t>
    <t s="19">(in the manner of a servant who requests),</t>
    <t s="20">for the matter of self-nullification is that one departs from one's own existence,</t>
    <t s="21">an elevation from below to above.</t>
    <t s="22">And Torah is the word of G-d</t>
    <t s="23">[which exists even before a person's engagement in Torah],</t>
    <t s="24">and the effect that is accomplished through a person's engagement in Torah is that the Torah and the Ein Sof clothed within it are drawn down to the person.</t>
    <t s="25">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="26">that even the drawing down of the Torah and the Ein Sof clothed within it into the person engaged in Torah,</t>
    <t s="27">is</t>
    <t s="28">(not through the person nullifying his intellect,</t>
    <t s="29">but on the contrary)</t>
    <t s="30">that the Torah is drawn down and clothes itself in the person's intellect as it is in his existence,</t>
    <t s="31">an influence from above to below.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Prayer's connection to the "upward without end" aspect of Ein Sof generates a new will beyond the order of Seder Hishtalshelus and Torah, yet Torah's influence is a direct drawing down of G-dliness itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that just as with Torah,</t>
    <t s="2">its connection to the matter of "downward without end" is to this [aspect] that Ein Sof is "downward without end,"</t>
    <t s="3">that the Torah, which is the wisdom and will of the Holy One, blessed be He, is drawn down downward,</t>
    <t s="4">so too is it with prayer,</t>
    <t s="5">that the connection of prayer to the matter of "upward without end" is</t>
    <t s="6">(not only because prayer is the elevation of the person,</t>
    <t s="7">but also)</t>
    <t s="8">to this [aspect] that Ein Sof is "upward without end."</t>
    <t s="9">For this, that through prayer a new will is aroused to fulfill the request of the one praying</t>
    <t s="10">[even when according to the wisdom of the Torah he is not worthy of it],</t>
    <t s="11">is because through prayer an ascent is made in the light above,</t>
    <t s="12">which is elevated above the order of Seder Hishtalshelus,</t>
    <t s="13">and above even the Torah,</t>
    <t s="14">until upward, upward without end,</t>
    <t s="15">and from there a new will is drawn down to fulfill his request.</t>
    <t s="16">However, nevertheless, there is an advantage in the influence of Torah over the influence through prayer.</t>
    <t s="17">For the influence through prayer,</t>
    <t s="18">since prayer is the work of the lower being,</t>
    <t s="19">therefore even the influence from above that comes through prayer is in relation to worldly matters</t>
    <t s="20">(the fulfillment of the request of the one praying),</t>
    <t s="21">except that the root of the influence is from upward, upward without end.</t>
    <t s="22">And the influence of Torah,</t>
    <t s="23">which is an influence from above from its own side,</t>
    <t s="24">is an influence of G-dliness.</t>
    <t s="25">For even after the Torah descended below and clothed itself in human intellect, it is the wisdom of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is above the intellect of created beings.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
